newsitem.title: USA: Innkeepers names COO, general counsel.
newsitem.headline: Innkeepers names COO, general counsel.

text.p: Innkeepers USA Trust said Monday that Frederic Shaw, 45, has joined the company as chief operating officer and executive vice president.
He had been a senior executive with JF Hotel Inc, which leases all of Innkeepers USA Trust's hotels, and substantially involved in managing all phases of the operation of Innkeepers' hotels.
The company also said it named announced that Mark A. Murphy, 35, general counsel and secretary.

He was previously a partner at the law firm of Hunton & Williams, where his experience centered on REITs and other real estate companies, said Innkeeperss, and has represented the company since its formation.
Both positions, said the company, are newly created in anticipation of further growth through acquisition.

Innkeepers USA currently owns a geographically diversified portfolio of 35 hotels in 16 states with an aggregate of 4,302 rooms. The company said it is focused on acquiring premier upscale extended-stay hotels in markets with high barriers to entry, and is one of the largest owners of Residence Inn by Marriott hotels.
